title: 국립장애인도서관 이용규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1

Article 2 (Scope of Application)
These Rules shall apply to the use of library materials (hereinafter referred to as "library materials") as defined in subparagraph 2 of Article 3 of the Libraries Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Act") held by the National Library for the Disabled under Article 24 (1) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Library"), and to the use of Library facilities: Provided, That matters concerning the use of certain materials, including special materials and valuable materials, shall be determined by the Director of the National Library for the Disabled (hereinafter referred to as the "Director"). <Amended on December 8, 2022.>
